meta.notes: Method v3 step 5c (prospecting) for primary ICP 'Mid-sized Commercial General Contractors' (50-250 employees). Sources are the companies' own public pages only. About 30 more candidate GCs were dropped because Preuve could not fetch them (403, robots.txt, TLS chain errors, DNS) or their pages had no usable text. Headcount is stated by only 3 of 22 companies; the rest are 'size unknown' (0 size points). No public evidence about software stacks was found (technology fit 0). Contacts: only 3 people whose name and title appear together in a verified quote on their company's own page. No emails collected. Brinkmann's problem evidence re-cites its process document imported on 2026-11-01.
